result.title: Safety as a Budget: Calibrating the Control Channel of Constrained GRPO for Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Reinforcement learning can teach vision-language models (VLMs) to decline harmful image-text requests, but how safe the result becomes is set indirectly, through reward weights found by trial runs. Stating safety as budgets on the rate of harmful assistance and the rate of over-refusal, enforced by Lagrange multipliers inside GRPO with an off-the-shelf scorer as the cost, is the natural fix, and it fails twice. The multiplier compares the scorer's mean with the budget, and scorers built for ranking get the mean wrong: a fixed-point analysis shows that the mean bias, not the budget, then decides whether the multiplier settles, saturates or switches off. And standard GRPO standardizes the penalized reward within each group, which cancels the multiplier before it reaches the gradient. Two-channel constrained GRPO repairs both: the base reward keeps the raw score for the within-group comparison, the penalty and the constraint estimate pass through a monotone map fitted on judge-labeled training responses, and the advantage keeps the multiplier. On a Qwen3-VL-2B policy with a training-free readout of an open 4B model as the scorer, held-out harm on 1,037 adversarial prompts falls from 8.9% under standard GRPO to 4.8%, lower in every seed, where the uncalibrated budget gives 7.6%; over-refusal stays at most 2% on 400 benign queries and MMBench is unchanged. The gain is largest where the intent sits in the image (10.1% -> 5.1%) and grows on the unseen HADES benchmark (28.9% -> 12.8%). Order-preserving distortions of the scores reproduce each predicted controller state in every seed, and the results hold under a map fitted on another judge's labels, an image-reading judge and a human audit.

AI.brief_summary: 该文把 VLM 的安全性表述为「有害应答率」与「过度拒答率」的预算约束，在 GRPO 中用 Lagrange 乘子施加惩罚，并指出均值偏差会使乘子失效、组内标准化会抵消乘子，进而提出双通道 constrained GRPO：保留原始奖励做组内比较、惩罚与约束估计经单调映射校准，使乘子进入 advantage。
AI.relevance_reason: 不涉及 latent 视觉推理或证据筛选，但「组内标准化抹掉乘子信号」与双通道 advantage 设计对 VLM 强化学习中代价项与行为率的贡献分配（如 look/stop 预算控制）可能提供可核查的训练侧线索。
